_comment: A scripted Daily Word game (answer 'slate') as the app records it: a refusal (not a word), crane, a refusal (already guessed), least, stale, slate (the win). Produced by frontend/src/game/daily_word/replay.ts through the GameRecorder with a clock stepping 3000 ms; frontend/src/game/daily_word/__tests__/replay.fixture.test.ts fails when the app's output differs, and backend/tests/test_daily_word_guess_event.py validates and replays it.
